summary: Brazil dominated the session on 26 Oct: the Brazil ETF EWZ fell about 20%, Petrobras (PBR) about 14%, and the ECB reference rate showed the real about 10.7% weaker against the dollar; the cause was not confirmed in this run. Brent was around $116 early Tuesday and US equity indices were little changed, with S&P 500 futures up 0.1% ahead of the Fed meeting that began 27 Oct. In Asia the Nikkei rose 1.7% early Tuesday while the Shanghai Composite fell 1.3% and the Hang Seng 0.7%; European shares opened lower on energy prices and HSBC results. Natural gas (Henry Hub) fell about 5.6% on its latest print and Bloom Energy rebounded 5.5% after an 11% drop on 23 Oct.

climate.detail: Climate Prediction Center says Nino-3.4 is +2.1C and El Nino continues to strengthen; chance of a historic event is 83% for October-December. Next update 12 Nov.

climate.headline: China's National Climate Centre flags possible 'super El Nino' peaking Nov-Dec
climate.detail: Centre said Pacific warming should peak in November-December; July disasters left 318 dead or missing and $8.5 billion in direct losses (older report, 18 Aug).
climate.source: National Climate Centre via CCTV, reported by The Standard, 18 Aug 2026

climate.headline: Rhine at Kaub hits record low, limiting barge loads
climate.detail: Gauge fell to 2 cm on 25 Sep, breaking the record; vessels sail part-loaded. Latest level not found for this run.

climate.headline: BoM: above-average rain more likely across northern Australia as El Nino develops
climate.detail: Fortnight 24 Oct-6 Nov outlook favours wetter northern Australia, cooler days; cyclone risk rises from November.
climate.source: Bureau of Meteorology Tropical Climate Update, 20 Oct 2026

climate.headline: Vietnam forecasts very strong El Nino through Dec, with 20-40% rain deficits in the south
climate.detail: Forecasters see fewer storms than average and very high drought and saltwater-intrusion risk in early 2027.
climate.source: National Center for Hydro-Meteorological Forecasting via VietnamNet, 24 Sep 2026

indicators.name: US rotary rig count (Baker Hughes)

indicators.name: US working gas in storage (EIA)
indicators.note: Thursday release for the week ending the prior Friday. The EIA page can return an old cached copy: check that its week-ending date matches the period before recording a value.

indicators.name: Refined copper market balance, year to date (ICSG)
indicators.note: Positive is surplus, negative is deficit, cumulative within the year. Reached through press reports quoting ICSG.

indicators.name: US reactors at 0% power (NRC daily report)
indicators.note: Count of units shown at 0% on the Friday daily report at nrc.gov (URL pattern .../reactor-status/2026/YYYYMMDDps.html). Autumn refuelling pushes the count up. Counted from the page text, so check the count against the page.

indicators.name: Uranium spot price, month-end (Cameco)
indicators.note: Cameco's page lists the month-end spot and long-term price; the long-term price is kept in the note.

spreads.name: Brent minus WTI

spreads.name: Copper to aluminum price ratio

spreads.name: Copper to gold ratio
spreads.note: Copper USD per pound divided by gold USD per ounce, times 1000. A familiar growth-versus-safety gauge.
